ops.title: What claude-pool is, its architecture/milestones, and the current build state

ops.body:
**cc-pool** (renamed from claude-pool on 2026-06-06; `~/Code/claude-pool` local dir → github.com/yasyf/cc-pool, PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0, Go, macOS-only): a maintained multi-account pool for Claude Code. The user runs several Claude Max/Pro subscriptions and wants predictive start-of-session load-balancing: `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$(clp select) claude` launches on the emptiest account. Binary `cc-pool` with `clp` symlink. LaunchAgent label `com.yasyf.cc-pool`. Subcommands: init, add, select, status, list, run, env, doctor, remove, service, daemon (hidden) — there is NO `ccp sync`; overlay re-assertion happens via doctor --fix, select/run, and the daemon poll.

Architecture (as of 2026-06-06, acct-00 ELIMINATED): each account = a real unique config dir (`~/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-NN`, ids start at 1) with its own per-dir Keychain item AND its own independent OAuth grant — the user's main subscription joins via plain `clp add` (a second `claude /login`), so the pool NEVER touches the canonical unsuffixed item or plain claude's token (old mirror/lockstep/never-refresh machinery deleted; `keychain.DefaultServiceName` deleted so no code can even name the unsuffixed item; pinned by TestPoolNeverTouchesDefaultKeychainItem). `~/.claude` is only the shared overlay base — never a pool account. PrepareAdd seeds each account's private `.claude.json` from `~/.claude.json` (strips only top-level `oauthAccount`; login rewrites it) so pooled sessions skip claude's first-run onboarding — claude reads `$CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json` when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set, `~/.claude.json` otherwise, and writes it atomically (tmp.rand4+rename → symlinks/FIFOs at that path get destroyed; copy is the only viable seed). Per-account private overlay entries: `daemon/`, `ide/`, `backups/` (claude backs up .claude.json to `join(configDir,"backups")`, keeps 5, ≥60s apart — sharing it cross-contaminates restore prompts), plus `.claude.json` and `.claude.json.*` (overlay.PrivateEntry; fuse mirrorFS redirects them to `acct-NN.private`). `clp add` auto-inits (sqlite meta keys `initialized`/`overlay_kind` replace the old acct-00-row check) and silently starts/restarts the daemon (version-checked health ping → brew stop+start or launchctl kickstart). Overlay Setup/Sync refuse base==accountDir (like Teardown). Scoring picks emptiest by 5h/7d remaining minus active sessions/rate-limits. No secrets in SQLite — Keychain is sole secret store. Known gap (test-pinned, AGENTS.md): two concurrent PrepareAdds get the same index (no row until FinalizeAdd).

Status (2026-06-06): M0–M4 ALL BUILT + renamed to cc-pool + a deep Go-best-practices/style review applied, all pushed to github.com/yasyf/cc-pool; CI green. 40 Go tests pass. Repo now has STYLEGUIDE.md/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (Go-native, adapted from bioqa). Default build is pure-Go (no cgo); only the `-tags fuse` variant needs cgo+fuse-t. fuse live mount needs a one-time "Network Volumes" TCC grant (can't be auto-completed headless) so symlink is the shipping default. Stack: cobra, huh+lipgloss, modernc.org/sqlite, winfsp/cgofuse v1.6.0→fuse-t (dlopens libfuse-t.dylib; pin CGOFUSE_LIBFUSE_PATH since macFUSE's libfuse.2 loads first), stdlib http+unix socket, launchctl LaunchAgent. Key safety rule baked in (and now guarded at the `pool.refresh` chokepoint + regression-tested via `ErrRefuseAcctZeroRefresh`): daemon NEVER POST-refreshes acct-00 (shared single-use refresh token with plain claude); usage poll is 180s + exp backoff to avoid self-429. The refresh-concurrency hardening pass landed 2026-06-06 (commits 931b06d/d67b452/612f201/fc28784, after sticky-select b97e211): per-account mutex map on Manager serializes each account's read→refresh→write credential cycle (lock deliberately held across I/O — documented exception); Manager.OAuth is now a `Refresher` interface + new `Keychain CredentialStore` seam (sysKeychain adapter) so races are testable with fakes; daemon Server.wg tracks scheduler+handlers+preflight (8s-bounded) goroutines before teardown/db-close; pollOnce idle is reservation-aware; server ctx threaded through handlers. Three litmus-verified tests pin these (usage_race_test.go, pollonce_test.go, shutdown-drain in server_test.go). Gotcha learned: macOS sun_path caps unix-socket paths at 104 bytes — daemon tests put sockets in a short /tmp dir, and `t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())` keeps pollOnce tests off real ~/.claude. Residual (out of scope, noted in fc28784): daemonless CLI/doctor/Init credential writes are cross-process and would need a file lock. Releases v0.1.0–v0.3.0 tagged 2026-06-06. As of v0.3.0 the Homebrew formula is a BINARY formula (no go build dep): stable url = prebuilt universal (arm64+amd64 lipo) tarball from GitHub Releases; a `resource "fuse"` holds the second `-tags fuse` universal tarball (amd64 slice cross-compiled with `CC="clang -arch x86_64"`, ad-hoc re-signed post-lipo) picked at install time iff `/usr/local/lib/libfuse-t.dylib` exists; `--HEAD` keeps the source build. release.yml builds both tarballs, smoke-tests the fuse binary on a fuse-t-less runner (dlopen fallback), and bump-formula seds the urls' embedded version + two sha lines anchored by trailing `# pure`/`# fuse` comments (fail-loud greps; prerelease tags skip the bump). Researched + rejected: cask (no brew services, quarantine xattr breaks ad-hoc-signed binaries), bottles (redundant once url is a binary), goreleaser (`brews` pipe deprecated for casks). Brew can't fetch "latest" at install time by design (pinned sha model) — auto-bump-on-tag is the idiom. Still remaining: human-only E2E (clp add real subscriptions) per docs/VERIFICATION.md. The user's standing rule (2026-06-06, stated emphatically twice; RE-STATED 2026-06-10 after I wrote ensureColumns ALTER-migration + race-tolerance code and he had it all ripped out): never write migration/legacy/back-compat code for this tool; breaking changes are clean fresh starts ("as if nothing before now ever existed"). As of 2026-06-10 there are exactly TWO installs — the local machine and `ssh yasyf@yasyf-home` — and schema changes are applied by hand-run SQL on both (done for the extra_* columns; legacy opus columns dropped from the local DB then too). The old ErrRefuseAcctZeroRefresh guard + acct-00 concepts are deleted; an adversarial review flagged that a stale acct-00-era pool.db opened by the new guard-free binary would refresh plain claude's mirrored token (logout) — the user explicitly chose NOT to guard against this (purged his own state). See [[claude-pool-keychain-derivation]].

v0.15.0 (2026-06-10, commit 5af781f5): plugin-state poisoning fix — pooled sessions stamped acct-anchored installLocation/installPath into the SHARED ~/.claude/plugins jsons, which claude's no-symlink-resolution string validator then rejected ("corrupted installLocation"); fixed by injecting `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR=~/.claude/plugins` in execEnv/LoginCommand/`ccp env`, and the `ccp add` shell alias became `alias claude='ccp run'` (run owns the whole launch env; printNextSteps/README/root help all run-centric now). Per the no-back-compat rule, NO normalizer/doctor machinery was added — existing poison was hand-respelled once. Full claude-side internals in [[claude-pool-keychain-derivation]]. Caveat: sessions launched before v0.15.0 (or via bare `$(ccp select)` without the env var) can still write acct-anchored paths; the fix is prevention-only.

**v0.15.1 (2026-06-11) — remote-settings.json wedge + plans-sharing facts.** Plans sharing (v0.13.0, `13b343c`) WORKS and the one-off consolidation of old per-account plans was done 2026-06-08 — nothing was lost (verified against full prompt history; absentees were claude's own ~30-day plan cleanup). When the user says plans "aren't shared": claude prints `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/plans/<slug>.md`, so pooled sessions display `~/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-NN/plans/...` — cosmetic only, the symlink makes it the same dir as `~/.claude/plans` (no env var/setting exists to relocate or re-display it; would need upstream claude change). The real recurring failure class: claude lazily births a new top-level file in `$CONFIG_DIR` before it exists in `~/.claude`; once base gains it, Sync hits "cannot link: a non-symlink already exists there" (remote-settings.json wedged acct-01/02 every 3-min poll, 2026-06-10→11). v0.15.1: remote-settings.json (+`remote-settings.json.*`) → PrivateEntry; Sync removes stale symlinks at private names (self-heal) and errors.Join's per-entry failures instead of aborting at the first (which had silently blocked all later entries); Health flags symlink-at-private-name. Watch for the next such file claude invents — same diagnosis, same fix shape. Known cosmetic leftovers (user declined pruning): dangling acct symlinks `image-cache`, `settings.json.bak`, `settings.json.orig` for base-removed entries.

**v0.19.0 (2026-06-11) — derived account names + `ccp rename`.** Default labels are now derived from the login email via `pool.LabelForEmail` (internal/pool/label.go): consumer providers (descope/go-free-email-providers HubSpot list checked against the eTLD+1 from x/net/publicsuffix, plus a hand supplement for proton.me/pm.me/hey.com/tutanota/tuta.io/skiff.com) keep the local part minus +tag; org domains take the registrable domain's leftmost label, ≤4 runes unhyphenated → ALL CAPS (UCSF), else per-hyphen-segment capitalized (Aneta). `ccp rename <acct> <name>` + `ccp rename --auto [refs]` (overwrites only empty/raw-email labels unless --force) via new `store.SetAccountLabel` (single-column UPDATE — deliberately not UpsertAccount, which could clobber the daemon's concurrent overlay_kind fallback write). `parseAccountRef` accepts `3`/`03`/`acct-03` and now also backs `remove`. Both installs' 6 accounts renamed 2026-06-11 (Aneta/yasyfm/Yasyf/rebecccafang/UCSF/rebeccafang_2005); local+remote ids differ (acct-01⇄03 swapped between machines). Renames are live — daemon reads labels from SQLite per request.

**v0.21.0 (2026-06-11) — `ccp migrate` (symlink⇄fuse overlay conversion) + cgofuse bump.** User-requested feature (NOT a back-compat shim — explicitly approved): converts existing accounts between overlay providers via a new daemon `OpMigrate` (only the daemon can: it hosts in-process fuse mounts and owns select reservations). Per-account sequence: gate (procscan + reservations + converting claim) → MovePrivateEntries(dir→acct-NN.private) BEFORE symlink Teardown (Teardown RemoveAll's backups/) → mount → identity verified THROUGH the mount → row flip LAST (crash ⇒ re-run converges). Busy accounts skip; re-run sweeps. `--to symlink` is the retreat, and works even in pure-Go builds (fuse-t uninstalled) via a verify-unmounted teardown — never hands the dir to the silently-substituted symlink provider. Fixed latent `fallbackToSymlink` bug that stranded `.claude.json` in `.private`; daemon startup `reconcileOverlays` now heals stranded files, sweeps mount-underlay leftovers before mounting, and clears stale mountpoints. Race-closure pattern: `converting` map (hides from select, two-sided with `tryReserve`) + `polling` map (scheduler/reconcile per-account claim; closes the pollOnce TOCTOU) under `s.mu`; flags own the account across mount I/O. `mountReady` is kind-symmetric (fuse row needs mount; symlink row needs NO mount). Forced CLI picks route through the daemon's gates. `store.SetAccountOverlayKind` single-column UPDATE (same rationale as SetAccountLabel). handleMigrate has a 120s budget (overflow → busy) under the 140s conn deadline. An adversarial multi-agent review confirmed 14 findings (2 P0 races) — all fixed + test-pinned pre-release. ALSO: cgofuse bumped v1.6.0→master pseudo-version because **v1.6.0 never read CGOFUSE_LIBFUSE_PATH** (macFUSE's kext libfuse.2.dylib always won when both installed — the env pin in fuse.go init() and the formula plist was a no-op until this bump). **v0.22.0 (same day)** added `ccp migrate --force` (skips ONLY the live-session gate — user vouches sessions are idle; reservations/claims still refuse) because live-but-idle claude tabs are the common case. ROLLOUT COMPLETE 2026-06-11, BOTH MACHINES: all 6 local + all 6 yasyf-home accounts on fuse, meta default=fuse everywhere; verified per-account identity through the mirrors, zero leakage into ~/.claude (no symlinks, no .claude.json in base), all 309 plans intact through the mirror; the working session itself was force-migrated live and survived. Backups deleted after verification (user-requested). Local daemon deployed via keg swap pre-formula-bump (binary stamped identically to the v0.22.0 release artifact; gotcha: cp-over-a-signed-binary in place → SIGKILL from the kernel signature cache — must rm + fresh cp + `codesign --force -s -`). yasyf-home gotchas: fuse-t cask install needs interactive sudo (user ran it via TTY ssh); `brew services restart` over SSH left the job loaded-but-never-spawned ("last exit code = (never exited)") — `launchctl kickstart gui/$UID/homebrew.mxcl.cc-pool` fixed it; no TCC Network Volumes prompt was needed on either machine. Standing caution: `brew services restart cc-pool` now force-unmounts all fuse accounts — restart only when sessions are closed. Over plain SSH the Keychain is locked, so `ccp doctor` shows credential-not-found there — SSH artifact, not breakage (the Aqua-session daemon reads fine).

**Widget net-burn + readability pass — RELEASED as v0.24.0 (2026-06-12, commit 349585fe, both formula+cask bumped; local machine upgraded + cache-killed, yasyf-home still pending).** User decisions: widget shows %-USED everywhere (header "Pool N% used", rows/bars/projections/7d all used — the user FIRST chose %-remaining on 2026-06-11, then REVERSED to used the next morning; don't 'fix' it back), header caption is NET burn (forecast.Pool.NetBurnPerHour: 1h-horizon projected drop of the pool's MEAN remaining, crediting 5h refills inside the hour; "burn N%/h"/"refilling N%/h"/"cruising"), projections read "→N% by reset", footer is coarse static "updated Nm ago" (provider paginates 5×1min + 12×5min entries because .after(5m) sits below WidgetKit's reload throttle). Wire key `net_burn_5h_per_hour` is deliberately NOT omitempty — absent strictly means pre-field daemon (widget falls back to gross); gross Burn5hPerHour stays the SUM and feeds DryAt. **Critical gotcha solved: macOS chronod caches widget metadata (size families) keyed by CFBundleVersion, and XcodeGen writes LITERAL version values into generated Info.plists — xcodebuild MARKETING_VERSION/CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION overrides are silent no-ops unless project.yml info.properties references $(MARKETING_VERSION)/$(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION).** That's why the widget shipped as 1.0(1) forever and the gallery never gained the large size (killall chronod doesn't help; the persisted descriptor only invalidates on version change). Fixed: $(…) wiring on both targets, release.yml stamps tag + commit-count with a plutil fail-fast assertion on app AND appex, dev builds use CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=$(date +%s) (commit count is constant across uncommitted rebuilds). Proven locally with an epoch-stamped install, then end-to-end via the v0.24.0 cask: CFBundleVersion 106 (commit count) on app+appex, chronod regenerated all three placeholders including systemLarge. Local daemon deliberately NOT restarted post-upgrade (fuse force-unmount caution) — the net-burn caption shows its gross fallback until `brew services restart cc-pool` runs at a quiet moment on each machine. (A reviewer note from this session — "the fuse live merged view doesn't exist, SplitClaudeJSON is dead code" — was a mid-build snapshot of the propagation feature between its phases; both landed hours later, see the propagation paragraph below. No longer true.)

**v0.23.0 (2026-06-12) — .claude.json shareable-key propagation** (commit d13c5ffc, scoped to the feature's 21 files; the widget/forecast work stayed uncommitted in the working tree; release.yml green, formula bumped; NOT yet deployed to either machine's daemon — needs brew upgrade + daemon restart with sessions closed, since restart force-unmounts fuse accounts; until then accounts run the pre-merge binary). Also fixed in this commit: the two -tags fuse pool add-path tests that were red since the migrate work (fresh-store tests inherited Detect()'s fuse pick on a fuse-capable machine → in-process mount in a CLI test process; now pinned to symlink via SetDefaultOverlayKind — first time the full fuse-tagged suite is green). Release gotchas hit: remote main had moved (formula-bump bot) → jj git fetch + rebase needed; jj git fetch/push need PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin git (2.51) — the shell-default git predates jj's required --porcelain support, just like shell-default go is 1.15 vs /opt/homebrew/bin/go 1.26. Root cause it fixes: Chrome-in-Claude toggles (`claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled`/`cachedChromeExtensionInstalled`) live in `.claude.json`, which was seed-once + PrivateEntry — vanilla changes never reached pool accounts. Design (user-locked): blacklist model — every top-level key propagates EXCEPT `overlay.ClaudeJSONPrivateKeys` = {oauthAccount, userID, anonymousId, projects, firstStartTime, numStartups}. Symlink arm: one-way base-wins merge at launch (`pool.MergeBaseClaudeJSON`, gated on the RECORDED row kind via the `m.overlayFor` seam) hooked at ALL FOUR launch paths — prepareAccount (forced+live), the daemon outcomePicked fast path (which bypasses prepareAccount entirely!), and `ccp env`. Fuse arm (the production path post-migrate-rollout): live merged view (synthetic read handles ≥1<<62, merge cache keyed on both files' mtime+size, Getattr Size=merged + Mtim=max(private,base)) with two-way write-through of shareable keys to `~/.claude.json` on rename-commit and dirty-fd Release (per-fd dirty tracking so a clean write-capable fd's close pushes nothing; readErr/writeErr split surfaced via FuseProvider.Health). Private file keeps the FULL payload — load-bearing for migrate (MovePrivateEntries moves it verbatim; convertToFuse re-reads identity through the merged view, which always sources oauthAccount from private — pinned by a live-mount test with an impostor base identity, where breaking the blacklist made the production rollback fire). Migrate-interplay guard: launch merge refuses to recreate a missing account file when a stranded copy sits in FusePrivateRoot (recreating would manufacture the moveEntry collision that wedges HealStrandedPrivate) and refuses Mounted(accountDir). Gotchas found by adversarial review, all fixed + litmus-pinned: bare-`null` JSON unmarshals to a nil map → panic (parseObject rejects non-objects); the `changed` no-write short-circuit needed json.Compact+json.HTMLEscape normalization of base values because real ~/.claude.json is PRETTY-PRINTED while merged output is json.Marshal-compacted (byte-compare never matched → rewrote the account file every launch); fuse write-through skips byte-identical no-ops (else it rewrote base every few seconds and invalidated every mount's merge cache). Declined per the no-guard-layers rule: base==accountDir refusal in mergeClaudeJSON (reviewer-audited unreachable + provably no-op). Known pre-existing red (NOT this feature, confirmed at parent commit 08360ff2): `go test -tags fuse ./internal/pool/` fails TestPrepareAddRepairsHalfAddedDir + TestPrepareAddPurgesStaleKeychainItem ("fuse: mount failed with error: -1"). Symlink-arm limitation (documented, by design): in-pool changes to shareable keys revert at next launch — manage shared settings in vanilla, or fuse gives two-way.

**Mount-holder decoupling (2026-06-12, BUILT + REVIEWED, ~10k-line diff UNCOMMITTED in the working tree — supersedes the "brew services restart force-unmounts" standing caution once deployed).** Fuse mounts moved out of the daemon into a detached `cc-pool mount-holder` process (hidden subcommand, same binary for TCC; socket `~/.cc-pool/mounts.sock`, flock-guarded never-evict bind): daemon restarts/upgrades/eviction no longer touch mounts (`teardownMounts` deleted), so `brew services restart cc-pool` is mount-safe. New packages `internal/mountd` (frozen additive proto-1: health/probe/mount/unmount/list/shutdown; error classes tcc/mount-failed/wedged/foreign-mount/busy/base-mismatch + ErrUnknownClass→retry; untagged RemoteProvider replaces deleted `overlay.For`/`Detect` via `pool.OverlayProviderFor`) and `internal/peerpid` (KillPid = identity-gated SIGKILL in one dial). Daemon supervises: 10s loop, crash respawn+backoff+verify (zombie-socket aware), reverse-skew steady state (spawned-newer holder never re-replaced — opt_bin swap makes old-daemon+new-holder routine), idle-gated skew replace behind a pool-wide claim fence (sessions+reservations+conversions+uptime≥TTL+pre-row-dir deferral, fail-closed scan); selection trusts only the cached holder vouch (carcass mounts can hang lstat — all wedge-prone stats now bounded via overlay.StatProbes/MountedWithin). Mount failures classified — unavailable/busy/TCC/wedged retry, only genuine failure reaches the now-session-gated fallbackToSymlink. `ccp service uninstall` gates on sessions (+--force, which never skips the purge mount-safety abort); purge hard-aborts on live mountpoints (fixed pre-existing RemoveAll-through-mirror catastrophe, CLI cross-process MNT_FORCE, pure-build wrong PrivateRoot). Holder visible in status/service status/doctor. 931 tests, race-clean; checkpoints in /tmp/mount-holder-checkpoints/. Built via per-step adversarial workflow (the review caught: cold-start select refusal, 60s sweep select-window, kill-identity race). REMAINING: review loop never reached dry (spend limits killed rounds 4-6; rounds 1-3's 15+ findings all fixed — incl. daemon listen() flock port), final on-device matrix per docs/MOUNT-HOLDER-VERIFICATION.md (restart-under-session, kill -9 respawn, skew defer, uninstall gates, TCC across binary swap), commit+release. One-time transition: the upgrade INTO this version still drops mounts once (old binary's teardownMounts runs at its own SIGTERM).

**fusekit extraction (2026-06-17, MERGED to main on both repos — supersedes the in-tree `internal/mountd` above).** The FUSE-T mount machinery is now a standalone public library **`github.com/yasyf/fusekit`** (PolyForm-Noncommercial, Go 1.26.2, cross-platform darwin FUSE-T + linux libfuse3, tagged **v0.1.1**) consumed by BOTH cc-pool and cc-notes. So `internal/mountd` NO LONGER EXISTS in cc-pool (deleted; it's `github.com/yasyf/fusekit/mountd` now — the detached holder: frozen proto-1 wire, Client, the narrow `Host` seam, a `Version`-injected `Server`, `Spawn`+`ErrCannotHost`, `RemoteHost`). The root `fusekit` pkg holds the mount-core primitives + the fuse host (`Mount`/`Serve`/`Config`/`Handle`, `CacheDefeat` decorator, `*MountSet{Build,StateFn}`, `HostProbe`, `Mounted`/`MountAlive`/`ForceUnmount`/`ClearCarcass`/`StatProbes`/`VersionNsec`/`MountOptions`, sentinels). cc-pool changes: `internal/overlay` is now a THIN ALIAS/WRAPPER BOUNDARY (sentinels `= fusekit.X` aliased for errors.Is identity; `StatProbes`/`Mounted`/`MountAlive`/`ForceUnmount` re-exported); `overlay.InProcessFuse()` returns a package-global `*fusekit.MountSet` (FuseProvider kept as the thin Provider type so pool tests' `&overlay.FuseProvider{}` still works) — the duplicated mount lifecycle is GONE, cc-pool GAINED cgofuse-load panic-recovery (→`ErrFuseUnavailable`) + `ClearCarcass`. STAYS app-side in overlay: the mirrorFS, the `.claude.json` merged view + write-through `flushWithin` drain (runs AFTER unmount — touches files outside the mount), `.ccp-probe` deep probe, `snapshotShared`/`sharedLink` perf carving, the byte-identical mount options (`volname=cc-pool-<base>,noattrcache,nobrowse,namedattr,rwsize=1048576`), the `CGOFUSE_LIBFUSE_PATH` init pin. New `internal/pool/{remotefuse.go (remoteFuse = struct{ *mountd.RemoteHost } + Kind/PrivateRoot), spawn.go (SpawnHolder)}`. Runtime byte-identical; wire/options/sentinel-identity preserved; holder Version = cc-pool's own `version.String()`. cc-pool main pushed at `ba4781cf` (CHANGELOG [Unreleased] + AGENTS.md note added; NOT yet tag-released). cc-notes also migrated (main `16acb9af`): remodeled onto the detached holder, cache-defeat moved behind `fusekit.CacheDefeat` (commitHandle error-split stays app-side), and **`ccn mount` now DETACHES by default + Ctrl-C no longer unmounts** (use `--stop`/`umount`; `--foreground` for the old blocking lifecycle). Both consumers pin the same cgofuse pseudo-version and fusekit v0.1.1. Built via phased dynamic workflows with per-phase adversarial verify; fusekit live fuse-t round-trips passed. The `[[reverify-commits-before-extracting]]` lesson came out of this work (cc-pool drifted v0.27.3→v0.28.1 mid-plan).

**v0.39.0 (2026-07-04) — File Provider backend SHIPPED; fleet off fuse entirely.** Third overlay
backend `fileprovider` (NSFileProviderReplicatedExtension): CCPoolFileProvider appex +
FileProviderController control server in the widget app (CCPoolStatusFP scheme; ad-hoc scheme
untouched), daemon FP bridge = second content.BridgeServer on the App Group socket sharing
PoolContentSource, reconcileFileProvider (ErrCannotControl-only retreat), three-way
ConvertOverlay + convertToFileProvider with shape-restoring rollbacks, --to fileprovider behind
fpGate, doctor reportFileProvider + HealthErrors wiring, release.yml signs the daemon with the
app-group entitlement. Live rollout doubled as recovery from the crashed old holder (10 EPERM
zombie mounts; onboarding-screen incident) — 9 accounts on FP domains, default=fileprovider,
acct-06/11/12 pending session-end. Two synthesis-caught bugs pre-release: AccountIdentity read
FP rows through the domain symlink (d11bafca class), fuseGate misrouted on FP-enabled machines
(fixed via DetectFuseBackend). Platform gotchas + recovery playbook: [[fp-backend-rollout]].
fusekit v0.29.1 (mux Teardown legacy arm) was the one upstream fix. NOTE the pushed release
commit 1a635ffe is titled "fix(fp): live-validation hardening..." but contains the ENTIRE
feature (a jj describe folded both — feature record preserved in the v0.39.0 tag annotation).

**v0.37.0 (2026-07-03) — model-scoped weekly limit (Fable) end-to-end.** Claude now enforces a separate weekly cap per model ("up to 50% of the weekly limit on Fable 5"); it arrives ONLY via a new top-level `limits` array in /api/oauth/usage (`kind:"weekly_scoped"`, `percent` NOT `utilization`, label from `scope.model.display_name` = "Fable"; `session`/`weekly_all` entries duplicate the old windows; old `seven_day_opus/sonnet` windows are all null now) — see [[claude-pool-keychain-derivation]]. cc-pool tracks it end-to-end: oauth `ScopedWeekly`/`BindingScoped` (max-util bucket wins) → store cols `scoped_7d_*` → score min-fold into eff7/raw7 (own reset for credit/self-lift/exhaustion; `Result.WeeklyExhausted` = agg||scoped) → wire `scoped_7d_util/resets/model` + `weekly_exhausted` (additive omitempty, no proto bump) → ccp status TUI third bar (dynamic label width, API label never truncated) + table badge + select suffix, widget third bar/medium badge (`WindowKind.scopedWeekly` gold→amber). Mood change (user-chosen): a pool whose every USABLE account is weekly-exhausted floors at MoodAlarmed (dry-out bump can still reach panic). **The no-migration standing rule was knowingly superseded here**: the user-edited, approved plan re-introduced `ensureColumn` ALTER-migration for the 3 columns (in-place upgrade at open, no pool.db wipe) — do not rip it out as a rule violation.
